title: The first letter, iii
logline: Wednesday. Gully reads the figure. He whistles. He looks at the table leg. He looks at Wood. He pours a coffee and says nothing for three panels.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY holding the letter — Wood brought it, creased from the table leg. WOOD on the stool. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man in an apron reading a creased letter at his counter while a thin man sits on the end stool with a dog beneath

panels.composition: Gully's face. A low whistle drawn as a small wavy line.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a man's face giving a low whistle drawn as a small wavy line

panels.composition: Gully pouring a coffee. Setting it down. Looking at Wood. Not saying it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man in an apron pouring a coffee and setting it in front of a thin man while visibly not saying something, no words

panels.composition: Gully handing the letter back. Wood folding it along the old crease.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man in an apron handing a letter back to a thin man who folds it along an existing crease

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The figure whistled at. 'Your table level?'
